mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising gross domestic product (GDP) indicates expanding economic demand, boosting corporate earnings and stock valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive GDP growth does not correlate with significant upward S&P 500 20-day returns, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% triggers bearish market sentiment, reducing investor confidence and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative 20-day returns occur despite UNRATE crossing above 5.5%, or the signal's significance (t-test p < 0.05) is not met.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in the federal funds rate and rising GDP signal accommodative monetary policy, amplifying equity valuation growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect shows no significant positive returns (p > 0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 18-month window when both proxies move as predicted.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime, a sustained drop in the federal funds rate below 2% signals effective policy normalization, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive returns do not occur when FEDFUNDS falls below 2% in high inflation periods, or the signal's t-test p-value exceeds 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: An upward movement in the INDPRO supply index reflects stronger production capacity, enhancing corporate profitability and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO rises but 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in monthly employment (PAYEMS) below 1.5 million triggers reduced consumer spending and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative returns persist despite PAYEMS falling below 1.5 million, or the signal's t-test p-value is not statistically significant (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in both production capacity (INDPRO) and economic demand (GDP growth) create synergistic effects, amplifying equity valuation growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises > 2% AND INDPRO crosses above 100
failure_condition: The combined effect of rising GDP and INDPRO does not result in significant positive returns (p > 0.05), or the interaction's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.
